build.beforeBuildCommand: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && mkdir -p app/src-tauri/resources && cp lolcommits PRIVACY.md app/src-tauri/resources/'
build.beforeDevCommand: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && mkdir -p app/src-tauri/resources && cp lolcommits PRIVACY.md app/src-tauri/resources/'

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; media-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A selfie for every git commit
